source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.4 with Example 4.2 (PDF 79-80).

blocks.text: Work ki definition (tareef) se yeh pata nahi chalta ke utna hi work ek second mein hua ya ek ghante mein. Practical (amli) kaamon mein aksar yeh jaanna zaroori hota hai ke work kis rate (kitni tezi) se ho raha hai.

blocks.title: Power
blocks.text: Power is baat ka measure (naap) hai ke work kis rate se ho raha hai.
Agar time interval (waqt ka chhota hissa) Δt mein work ΔW ho, to is dauran average (ausat) power P_av yeh hai:
Agar work ko time ke function ki form mein likha ja sake, to kisi bhi instant (lamhe) ki instantaneous power P yeh hai:
jahan ΔW bohat chhote waqt Δt mein kiya gaya work hai.

blocks.text_alt: Is liye   P = F · Δd / Δt = F · (Δd / Δt)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Power = force × velocity. Jo machine zyada force ke saath tez chalaye us ki power zyada hai. Maslan car charhai par chadhte waqt zyada force lagati hai; agar speed bhi wohi rakhe to zyada power chahiye.

blocks.title: Watt
blocks.text: Power ka SI unit watt (W) hai: ek second mein ek joule work = 1 watt (1 W = 1 J s⁻¹).
Kabhi kabhi, maslan electrical measurements (bijli ki naap tol) mein, work ka unit watt second likha jata hai. Lekin bijli ki energy ka commercial (karobari) unit kilowatt-hour hai.
Ek kilowatt-hour woh work hai jo ek kilowatt power wali machine (agency) ek ghante mein karta hai. Bijli ke bill par yahi “unit” hota hai.

blocks.text_alt: Is liye   1 kW h = 1000 W × 3600 s

blocks.title: Example 4.2
blocks.problem: 70 kg ka aadmi seerhiyon ki lambi qataar 4.0 s mein charh jata hai. Seerhiyon ki vertical (seedhi) oonchai 4.5 m hai. Us ki power output watts mein nikalein.
blocks.answer: P = 7.7 × 10² kg m² s⁻³ = 7.7 × 10² W (taqreeban 770 W)

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Ek car banane mein taqreeban 9 × 10⁹ J energy lagti hai, aur phir car apni poori zindagi mein petrol se taqreeban 1 × 10¹² J energy istemal karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Us crane ki power nikalein jo 1000 kg ko 20 s mein 100 m oopar uthaye (short question 4.4). 75 W ka pankha 30 din rozana 8 ghante chalta hai; units mein energy aur Rs 22.5 fi unit ke hisab se bill nikalein (numerical 4.5). Machine gun 40 g ki goliyan 700 m s⁻¹ par 6 goliyan fi minute chalati hai; us ki power nikalein (numerical 4.1).
blocks.explanation: Crane: P = mgh / t = 1000 × 9.8 × 100 / 20 = 49 000 W = 49 kW. Pankha: energy = 0.075 kW × 8 h × 30 = 18 kW h = 18 units, bill = 18 × 22.5 = Rs 405. Machine gun: har goli ki KE = ½ × 0.040 × (700)² = 9800 J; 6 goliyan 60 s mein = 58 800 J, to P = 58 800 / 60 = 980 W. (Kitab ka jawab 9800 W hai, jo ek goli fi second par banta hai; 6 goliyan fi minute par sahi jawab 980 W hai.)

items: Power = work karne ka rate: P_av = ΔW / Δt, P = limit ΔW / Δt = F · v.
Unit watt (1 W = 1 J s⁻¹); commercial unit 1 kW h = 3.6 × 10⁶ J. Example 4.2: 7.7 × 10² W.
